patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: It fit PERFECT and then it didn't come back out. I can still breathe out the other side. It's the blue one — my favorite.
clinical.presentationShort: 4yo M — witnessed plastic bead in R nostril, unilateral obstruction, comfortable, breathing well; not a battery or magnet.
clinical.presentationLong: 4-year-old male, placed a plastic bead in his right nostril, unilateral obstruction, breathing comfortably, with nothing to suggest a battery or magnet.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → removal (positive-pressure 'parent's kiss' or instruments); discharge.
diagnosis.why: Plain bead, breathing fine — simple removal. (Batteries and magnets in the nose ARE urgent — this isn't one.)

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting, pointing at his own nose
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 4-year-old boy, mischievous, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting, pointing at his own nose. Expression: a sheepish grin. Clearly visible: pointing at his right nostril, otherwise completely well. No text, no logos.
